cohort: Thirty patients in the second and third trimester of pregnancy with suspicion of placenta accreta on obstetric ultrasound were included.
finding: The Placenta Accreta Index (PAI) reliably identified patients at high risk of morbidly adherent placenta and adverse outcomes, with 84.6% of high-risk patients undergoing cesarean hysterectomy.
mod_finding: A high Placenta Accreta Index (PAI) significantly correlated with the primary maternal outcome of cesarean hysterectomy.
